completedFramesCSV.encoding: UTF-8/LF CSV. Every present cell is a JSON value (including quoted strings, lowercase booleans, explicit null, and arrays); blank means absent in original evidence. json.loads(nonblank cell) recovers exact typed value.

fieldSemantics.engineGeneration: Shared-engine generation; distinct from activationPlaybackGeneration and activationToken.
fieldSemantics.firstPositivePresentedHostSeconds: First valid positive drawable callback for that completed frame.
fieldSemantics.lastRedrawVideoMinusAudioSeconds: Last recorded redraw estimate; its host timestamp is not retained. Never join it to the first callback as one measurement.
fieldSemantics.feedbackHostSeconds: Feedback enqueue instrumentation, not worker acknowledgment or physical presentation.
fieldSemantics.steadyEligible: Predicate reported by that historical audit; original reasons retained. v2 temporary-unavailable rows were not silently removed.
fieldSemantics.reservedModelPayloadBytes: Process-wide immutable model-weight reservation accounting, not OS resident memory.

limits: Capture success, visibility eligibility, integrity audits, and product transport acceptance are separate.
All completed-frame rows retained, including warmup, failed candidates, missing presentation estimates, and occluded intervals.
Percentiles use linear interpolation at(n-1)*p; signed p95 and absolute-offset p95 answer different questions.
Baseline929c runs with current9f engine; earlier published905d-engine numbers are historical context, not this matched baseline.
No causal throughput comparison from differently paced media, no source-rate Live, physical HDR/A/V, energy, or M5/core-selection claim.
Large per-check audits, raw frame implementation fields, complete logs and resource samples remain pinned local sources. Optional v3 decision/authority records are retained separately when present.

publicationSource.changes: CSV filename adapted for publication; candidate review status added. Captured measurements and acceptance unchanged.
